parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the AIDA model of advertising.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the study by Kohli et al. (2007) on effective slogans.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two strengths of the study by Kohli et al.

parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about packaging, positioning and placement

parts.text: Outline one symptom of Munchausen syndrome.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the findings of the study by McKinstry and Wang (1991) of non-verbal
communications in the patient–practitioner relationship.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two weaknesses of the study by McKinstry and Wang.

Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the two factor theory of job satisfaction (Herzberg, 1959).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the job descriptive index (JDI) developed by Smith et al. (1969).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between the JDI and the quality of working life
(QWL) questionnaire (Walton, 1974).
